core_philosophy: Ultra-premium fintech digital wallet, combining the minimalist trust of Qonto with the cutting-edge tech aesthetics of Revolut Premium. Dark mode native with deep violet and metallic cyan accents. Heavy use of layered depth, subtle glassmorphism, and architectural typography.

headings.usage: Use for all Main Titles (Dashboard, Wallet, Solde Total), FREK-ID scores, and major numeric balances.

body_data.usage: Use for transaction tables, labels, body text, and UI components. Exceptional for tabular numbers.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 (use border-white/20 on hover). Cards must never have pure white borders.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Dashboard balance taking col-span-2 or 3.
layouts_and_grids.spacing_system: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 between dashboard widgets.
layouts_and_grids.sidebar: Fixed width (260px), sticky, borders on right side (border-white/10). Active menu item has bg-white/5 and bright left border.

component_guidelines.cards: Flat background (#12121A), border-white/10, rounded-3xl. Add 'overflow-hidden' for internal glowing effects or structural gradients.

buttons.primary: bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold shadow-glow transition-all
buttons.quick_action: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-2xl border border-white/5 hover:border-white/15 transition-all gap-2

component_guidelines.tables: Transaction tables should have hover states on rows (hover:bg-white/5). Align amounts to the right. Use neutral tones for amounts, relying on simple minus signs or muted greens for inflow to remain premium.
component_guidelines.progress_bars: For 'Coffres'. Height 8px, rounded-full, bg-zinc-800, fill bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-500 to-cyan-400.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift (-translate-y-1) and gain subtle border glow.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer motion opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0 on mount.
motion_and_interactions.list_stagger: Transaction list items stagger in on load.

media_and_icons.icon_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or regular weight for premium feel)

abstract_background.description: Abstract fluid dark texture for premium login/auth screen background or hero banner underlay.

avatar_frekid.description: Professional headshot for the FREK-ID user profile and certification.

vault_3d_glass.description: Abstract 3D curved glass shape for the Coffres (Vaults) visual decoration to add a premium aesthetic.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-muted against #12121A meets at least 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500 focus:outline-none for interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='send-money-btn', data-testid='total-balance').

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic Inter font. Import and use Cabinet Grotesk (headings) and Manrope (body).
DO NOT use pure white borders. Always use border-white/10 or border-white/5.
Build the dashboard using a Bento Grid approach. Ensure high density but with generous padding (p-6/p-8) inside the cards.
Ensure 'Convertir' shows the EUR to JCC rate (1 JCC = 1.50 EUR) beautifully.
Use Phosphor icons. Add animations to quick action buttons on hover.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., successful conversion or sending JCC).
FREK Score should visually represent a premium credit rating (e.g., glowing circular indicator or minimal gauge).
Never use generic 🤖🧠 emojis. Strictly rely on Phosphor Icons.
Do not center-align the main application container text. Left-align text for readability.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Do not create generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Apply specific transitions.
MUST NOT center align the app container in css.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-full with interaction animations).
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Include subtle grain textures or noise overlays for a premium look.
Always apply data-testid to interactive elements.
